    return boxes

# Time-box this. Let me hypothesize: rule = "for each pair of aligned (same row-run / same col-run) blocks of the same rare color, fill every ZERO cell strictly between them along that line" and verify.
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in I for v in row if v!=0)
    frame=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    for col in set(c for row in I for c in row)-{0,frame}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==col]
        # group into maximal row-runs and col-runs
        runs=[]
        seen=set()
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            comp={p}; stack=[p]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if q in set(pts) and q not in comp: comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
            for q in comp: seen.add(q)
            runs.append(comp)
        for comp in runs:
            cs=[c for r,c in comp]; rs=[r for r,c in comp]
            hgt,wid=max(cs)-min(cs)+1,max(rs)-min(rs)+1
            if hgt*wid==len(comp) and len(comp)>=2:  # solid rectangle block
                for p in comp:
                    seen_around={(q) for q in []}
        return O
    return O

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in I for v in row if v!=0)
    frame=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    for col in set(c for row in I for c in row)-{0,frame}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if O[r0][c]==0: O[r0][c]=col
            if O[r1][c]==0: O[r1][c]=col
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            if O[r][c0]==0: O[r][c0]=col
            if O[r][c1]==0: O[r][c1]=col
    return O

import collections
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in I for v in row)
    frame=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=0 and c!=frame]
    for col in colors:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==col]
        done=set()
        for i in range(len(pts)):
            for j in range(i+1,len(pts)):
                (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[i],pts[j]
                if r1==r2: seg=[(r1,y) for y in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1)]
                elif c1==c2: seg=[(x,c1) for x in range(min(r1,r2),max(r1,r2)+1)]
                else: continue
                if abs(r1-r2)!=abs(c1-c2): continue
                ok=all(I[a][b]==0 for a,b in seg)
                if ok:
                    for a,b in seg:
                        if O[a][b]==0: O[a][b]=col
    return O

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r if v!=0)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    markers=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=bg]
    def paint(r,c,v,dr,dc):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
            if I[rr][cc]==v: return
            if I[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=v
            else: return   # stop at any other nonzero
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    for r,c,v in markers:
        paint(r,c,v,1,0); paint(r,c,v,-1,0); paint(r,c,v,0,1); paint(r,c,v,0,-1)
    return out
